title: davila7/claude-code-templates
text: Open-source registry and CLI for Claude Code components: agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCPs, settings and mods https://www.aitmpl.com Claude Code Templates SUPPORTED BY An open catalog of components for Claude Code, installable with one command. Browse the catalog · Documentation · Contributing · Discussions · Changelog SPONSORED BY Proxy-Seller proudly supports this project. Reliable proxy infrastructure for any workflow: private residential, mobile (4G/5G/LTE), ISP, and datacenter IPv4/IPv6 proxies, all with HTTP(S) and SOCKS5 support. Residential IPs across 220+ locations, targeting by country, city, or ISP, and 24/7 support. About Claude Code is configured through small files: skills, subagents, slash commands, hooks, MCP servers and settings. Claude Code Templates collects more than 1,980 of them in one catalog at aitmpl.com, where you can search, preview every file a component writes, and combine several components into a single install command. The CLI writes each file to the right place and merges existing configuration instead of overwriting it. Every pull request is checked by Claude Code's plugin validator and scanned by NVIDIA SkillSpector. Quickstart Runs with npx, no global install needed. # Browse the catalog and install interactively npx claude-code-templates@latest # Install one component npx claude-code-templates@latest --skill creative-design/frontend-design # Install a stack in one command npx claude-code-templates@latest \ --agent development-team/frontend-developer \ --command testing/generate-tests \ --mcp integration/github-integration Add --yes to skip the confirmation prompt. Every component page on aitmpl.com shows its exact install command. To find one from the terminal: npx claude-code-templates@latest --search "code review". One example per component type npx claude-code-templates@latest --skill creative-design/frontend-design npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent development-tools/code-reviewer npx claude-code-templates@latest --command performance/optimize-bundle-size npx claude-code-templates@latest --mcp database/postgresql-integration npx claude-code-templates@latest --setting mcp/mcp-timeouts npx claude-code-templates@latest --hook git/conventional-commits npx claude-code-templates@latest --mod security/secret-redactor # Claude Code 2.1.287+ npx claude-code-templates@latest --loop engineering/docs-sweep-loop # also installs the components the loop uses npx claude-code-templates@latest --plugin productivity/champion-kit # via the aitmpl marketplace, Claude Code 2.1.288+ What's in the catalog Type Count What it is Examples Skills 918 Reusable capabilities with progressive disclosure PDF processing, frontend design, code review Agents 422 Subagents specialized in one domain Security auditor, frontend developer, database architect Commands 288 Custom slash commands /generate-tests, /optimize-bundle-size, /security-audit MCPs 119 External service integrations GitHub, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Supabase, Sentry Settings 80 Claude Code configuration Timeouts, permissions, status lines Hooks 63 Automation triggers Conventional commits, blocking direct pushes Mods 50 Plugins that change Claude Code's own interface and behavior Secret redaction, protected paths, terminal games Loops 18 Autonomous workflows with a goal, an interval and a stop condition Docs sweep, build-test-fix, adversarial review Templates 14 Complete project configurations Language and framework setups Sandboxes 11 Launchers that run Claude Code in an isolated environment (reference only, see cli-tool/components/sandbox/) E2B, Cloudflare, Docker Plugins 1 Whole Claude Code plugins, installed from the aitmpl marketplace Champion Kit Live counts: dashboard/public/counts.json. Local tools The CLI also ships three local tools. The two dashboards listen on 127.0.0.1 only, because they serve your conversation history. Command What it does npx claude-code-templates@latest --analytics Real-time session monitoring and usage metrics at localhost:3333 npx claude-code-templates@latest --chats Read and search your conversations in a mobile-friendly UI at localhost:9876 npx claude-code-templates@latest --health-check Diagnose your Claude Code installation and project setup To open the conversation browser from another device, forward the port over SSH: ssh -L 9876:localhost:9876 <host>. Flags removed in 1.31.0 --plugins, --skills-manager, --command-stats, --hook-stats, --mcp-stats, --agents, --chats-mobile, --teams, --2025, --studio, --sandbox, --tunnel, --create-agent, --list-agents, --update-agent, --remove-agent and --clone-session were removed. Running one prints what replaced it. To see what is installed in each scope, use the stack viewer mod (--mod ui/stack-viewer, then /stack in Claude Code). Details in the CHANGELOG. Documentation Guides, the CLI reference and the catalog API live at docs.aitmpl.com. Contributing Contributions are welcome. Read the contributing guide to add a skill, agent, command, MCP, setting, hook or mod, and the Code of Conduct before you open a pull request.
